newsitem.title: USA: TWA sets premium trans-Atlantic ticket promotion.
newsitem.headline: TWA sets premium trans-Atlantic ticket promotion.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Thursday it is offering a half-price companion ticket for its premium Trans World One service on trans-Atlantic flights when a full-fare ticket is also purchased.
The offer is for travel between John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York City and Rome, Milan, Madrid, Barcelona, Paris, Lisbon, Tel Aviv, Cairo, Athens or Riyadh.
Travel must be completed by March 15, and tickets must be purchased no later than 24 hours prior to departure. Round-trip travel is not required.
Tickets are refundable and changeable, TWA said, but any changes, refunds or modifications will apply to both the half-price companion and full-fare tickets.

TWA spokesman John McDonald said the airline's trans-Atlantic service has two classes, Trans World One, which is comparable to first class but has fares that compare to business class, and "comfort" or coach class.
The airline said this is the first time it has offered a discounted fare on Trans World One service to every trans-Atlantic destination.
